name: @dimm-city/print-md-viewer
author: itlackey
description: Desktop viewer for print-md (Electron + SvelteKit static SPA).

scripts.electron:dev: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron out/main/main.js
scripts.electron:hmr: npm run electron:build && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "vite dev --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron out/main/main.js"
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
